author: peacenchemicals
body:
Esan Rod Sap in Anaheim. been going since high school (2004-2008). the owner is almost always borderline rude. and one time one of the family members of the owner wrongly accused me of blocking the door way with my car. i didn’t go for like 2 years bc of that, but if they closed i would be devastated.

Trieu Chau on Newhope in Santa Ana/Garden Grove. they used to be soooo much busier. they’re still okay, but my parents have been going since they came to the US. I’d be so sad if they closed too
